title: MCP Fuzzer: Automated Boundary and Schema Stress-Tester for MCP Servers
one_liner: A CLI tool that inspects Model Context Protocol (MCP) server tool schemas and uses Claude to generate adversarial payloads, surfacing unhandled crashes and permission leaks.

title: claude-tool-guard: Real-time secret and PII redactor for tool-using Claude agents
one_liner: A zero-dependency Python wrapper for the Anthropic SDK that intercepts tool call inputs and outputs to block credential leaks and PII before execution.

title: claude-trace-diff - CLI tool call regression tester for Anthropic agents
one_liner: A CLI tool that captures Anthropic SDK tool execution sequences and flags argument drifts, missing tool calls, and hallucinations across prompt iterations.

title: Claude Callgraph – Visualize Claude tool-use traces
one_liner: A CLI that turns Claude agent tool-call logs into instant Mermaid diagrams for rapid debugging and insight
